definition_en: showing a lack of good sense, or slow to understand
core_image: 脑子像被敲了一下，愣在原地转不过弯
scene: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。He asked a stupid question.
sceneCN: 这里 stupid 是「愚蠢的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

senses.title: Foolish
senses.definition: showing a lack of good judgment
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏良好判断力的
senses.example: He asked a stupid question.
senses.exampleCN: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。
senses.why: This is the main sense of poor judgment.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示判断力差的主要义项。

senses.title: Slow to learn
senses.definition: slow to understand or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 理解或学习某事很慢的
senses.example: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
senses.exampleCN: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。
senses.why: The word shifts from judgment to ability.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从判断力转向了能力。

senses.title: Annoying
senses.definition: used informally to show annoyance
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来表示恼怒
senses.example: I forgot my stupid keys again.
senses.exampleCN: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。
senses.why: Anger lends the word a casual use.
senses.whyCN: 恼怒让这个词有了口语用法。

intro.en: Stupid comes from a Latin word meaning stunned.
intro.cn: stupid 来自拉丁语词，意为被惊得发愣。

items.en: Stupere meant to be stunned or numb.
Stupidus described a stunned, foolish person.
items.cn: stupidus 形容发愣、愚笨的人。

items.en: Stupide carried the sense into French.
items.cn: stupide 把这一含义带入法语。

items.en: Stupid described a foolish person or act.
items.cn: stupid 形容愚笨的人或行为。

items.en: Stupid became a common word of annoyance.
items.cn: stupid 成为常见的恼怒用语。

note.en: Stupid is compared with look-alike words and with words for foolishness.
note.cn: 把 stupid 与形近词以及表示愚笨的词作比较。

entries.definition: not sensible, often in a light way

normalIntro.en: Stupid is the mind standing still when it should move.
normalIntro.cn: stupid 是头脑该动的时候却停住了。

normal.en: He asked a stupid question.
normal.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

normal.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
normal.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

normal.en: I forgot my stupid keys again.
normal.cn: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。

normal.en: That was a stupid mistake.
How stupid of me to leave it outside.

abstract.en: Stupid is often just brave without information.
abstract.cn: 所谓愚蠢，常常只是没有信息的勇敢。

abstract.en: No one is stupid in every room.
abstract.cn: 没有人在每个房间里都笨。

abstract.en: The stupidest answer is the one never checked.
abstract.cn: 最笨的答案，是从未被核对的答案。

examples.en: He asked a stupid question.
examples.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

examples.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
examples.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

examples.en: That was a stupid mistake.

dict_mnemonic.text: stupid 是「愚蠢的」，也可表示「笨的」或口语里「恼人的」；stupid question 是愚蠢的问题，stupid mistake 是愚蠢的错误，feel stupid 是觉得自己很傻。

root: 来自拉丁语 stupere（惊呆、麻木）的形容词 stupidus，经法语 stupide 进入英语；由被惊得发愣，引申为头脑迟钝、缺乏判断，再有了口语里表示恼怒的用法。

sensesIntro.en: Stupid means foolish, slow to understand, or, informally, annoying.
sensesIntro.cn: stupid 表示愚蠢、迟钝，或口语中令人恼火。

core.en: A mind stopped by its own confusion.
core.cn: 被自己的困惑卡住的头脑。

branches.en: He asked a stupid question.
branches.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

branches.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
branches.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

branches.en: I forgot my stupid keys again.
branches.cn: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。

branches.en: Foolish acts and slow thinking share one word.
branches.cn: 愚蠢的行为和迟钝的思考共用一个词。

branches.en: A word for bad judgment became a word of anger.
branches.cn: 表示判断力差的词，也成了发怒时用的词。

intro.en: Stupid builds nouns and adverbs with -ity and -ly.
intro.cn: stupid 借助 -ity 和 -ly 构成名词和副词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base stup- meant stunned.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 stup- 意为惊呆。

items.example: It was the stupidest thing to say.
items.exampleCN: 那是能说出的最蠢的话。

items.example: He stupidly left the door open.
She could not believe his stupidity.
items.exampleCN: 她不敢相信他会这么蠢。

items.example: One stupid mistake cost them the game.
items.exampleCN: 一个愚蠢的错误让他们输掉了比赛。
我为开口问而觉得自己很傻。

latinEntries.exampleCN: stupidus 演变为英语的 stupid。

definition_en: a particular way of doing, making, or expressing something
core_image: 同一种动作，落在纸上却有各自的笔迹
scene: 这位画家有自己独特的风格。The painter has a style of her own.
sceneCN: 这里 style 是「风格」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这位画家有自己独特的风格。

senses.title: Artistic manner
senses.definition: a particular way an artist or writer expresses ideas
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家或作家表达思想的独特方式
senses.example: The painter has a style of her own.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家有自己独特的风格。
senses.why: This is the core sense in art.
senses.whyCN: 这是艺术领域的核心义项。

senses.title: Design
senses.definition: the design or shape of clothes or objects
senses.definitionCN: 衣服或物品的设计或样式
senses.example: She likes the style of that coat.
senses.exampleCN: 她喜欢那件外套的款式。
senses.why: Design borrows the idea of a manner.
senses.whyCN: 设计借用了「方式」这一概念。

senses.title: Way of acting
senses.definition: a way of behaving or working
senses.definitionCN: 行为或工作的方式
senses.example: His style is to listen first.
senses.exampleCN: 他的作风是先听别人说。
senses.why: A person's manner becomes a style.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的处事方式也成了作风。

intro.en: Style first named a pointed tool for writing.
intro.cn: style 最初指书写用的尖笔。

items.en: Stilus was a pointed writing tool.
Style named a manner of writing.
Style entered English as a way with words.
items.cn: style 作为用词方式进入英语。

items.en: Style widened to art and design.
items.cn: style 扩展到艺术与设计。

items.en: Style also named a way of living.

note.en: Style is compared with look-alike words and with words for manner.
note.cn: 把 style 与形近词以及表示方式的词作比较。

entries.definition: a popular way of dressing or behaving
the shape or plan of something

normalIntro.en: Style is the fingerprint of a way of doing something.
normalIntro.cn: style 是做事方式留下的指纹。

normal.en: The painter has a style of her own.
normal.cn: 这位画家有自己独特的风格。

normal.en: She likes the style of that coat.
normal.cn: 她喜欢那件外套的款式。

normal.en: His style is to listen first.
normal.cn: 他的作风是先听别人说。

normal.en: The letter was written in a formal style.
normal.cn: 这封信是用正式风格写的。

normal.en: That song is out of style now.

abstract.en: Style is what remains when the rules are forgotten.
abstract.cn: 规则被忘掉之后，留下的就是风格。

abstract.en: A style can be copied, but not the hand behind it.
abstract.cn: 风格可以被模仿，背后的那只手却不能。

abstract.en: Every age writes in its own style and calls it natural.
abstract.cn: 每个时代都用自己的风格书写，并称之为自然。

examples.en: The painter has a style of her own.
examples.cn: 这位画家有自己独特的风格。

examples.en: She likes the style of that coat.
examples.cn: 她喜欢那件外套的款式。

examples.en: His style is to listen first.
examples.cn: 他的作风是先听别人说。

dict_mnemonic.text: style 是「风格、款式、作风」；in style 是时髦地，out of style 是过时，writing style 是写作风格，style guide 是体例指南。

root: 来自拉丁语 stilus（书写用的尖笔），经古法语进入英语；由笔和笔迹，引申为写作与艺术表达的方式，再扩展为服装款式、做事作风和生活方式。

sensesIntro.en: Style is an artistic manner, a design, or a way of acting.
sensesIntro.cn: style 是艺术风格、设计款式，或行为作风。

core.en: The personal mark left on a common task.
core.cn: 在共同的事情上留下的个人印记。

branches.en: The painter has a style of her own.
branches.cn: 这位画家有自己独特的风格。

branches.en: She likes the style of that coat.
branches.cn: 她喜欢那件外套的款式。

branches.en: His style is to listen first.
branches.cn: 他的作风是先听别人说。

branches.en: Art and conduct both reveal a personal manner.
branches.cn: 艺术和为人，都显露出个人的方式。

branches.en: A coat and a habit can share the same style.
branches.cn: 一件外套和一种习惯，可以有同一种风格。

intro.en: Style builds adjectives and nouns with -ish, -ist, and -istic.
intro.cn: style 借助 -ish、-ist 和 -istic 构成形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base stilus named a writing tool.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词 stilus 指书写工具。

items.example: The two styles are very different.
The room is styled like a studio.
items.exampleCN: 这房间布置得像工作室。
他穿了一件时髦的外套。

latinEntries.exampleCN: stilus 演变为英语的 style。

definition_en: the topic being discussed, a course of study, a person studied, or being affected by something
core_image: 被放在讨论中央、供人观看与研究的那个东西
scene: 今天这节课的主题是天气。The subject of today's lesson is the weather.
sceneCN: 这里 subject 是「主题」（第 1 个义项）；句意：今天这节课的主题是天气。

senses.title: Topic
senses.definition: the thing being discussed or written about
senses.definitionCN: 正在被讨论或书写的事物
senses.example: The subject of today's lesson is the weather.
senses.exampleCN: 今天这节课的主题是天气。
senses.why: This is the basic topic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的主题义项。

senses.title: Course of study
senses.definition: an area of knowledge studied at school
senses.definitionCN: 在学校学习的一个知识领域
senses.example: History is her favourite subject.
senses.exampleCN: 历史是她最喜欢的科目。
senses.why: A topic of study becomes a school subject.
senses.whyCN: 被研究的主题成了学校科目。

senses.title: Person studied
senses.definition: a person or thing used in a test or study
senses.definitionCN: 用于测试或研究的人或物
senses.example: The subjects were asked to sleep well.
senses.exampleCN: 受试者被要求好好睡觉。
senses.why: Research places people under study.
senses.whyCN: 研究把人置于被观察的位置。

senses.title: Affected by
senses.definition: likely to be affected by something
senses.definitionCN: 容易受到某事影响的
senses.example: The schedule is subject to change.
senses.exampleCN: 日程可能会有变动。
senses.why: Being under control becomes being open to change.
senses.whyCN: 处于控制之下，引申为易受变动影响。

intro.en: Subject comes from Latin words meaning thrown under.
intro.cn: subject 来自拉丁语，意为被置于下方。

items.en: Subicere meant to throw under.
Subiectus meant placed under authority.
items.cn: subiectus 意为置于权力之下。

items.en: Sujet named a topic or a person ruled.
items.cn: sujet 指话题或被统治的人。

items.en: Subject named both a topic and a ruled person.
items.cn: subject 既指话题，也指臣民。

items.en: Subject became a school course and a study object.
items.cn: subject 成为学校科目和研究对象。

note.en: Subject is compared with look-alike words and with words for topics.
note.cn: 把 subject 与形近词以及表示主题的词作比较。

entries.definition: a thing you can see or touch
the main idea of a work

normalIntro.en: A subject is what a lesson, a study, or a ruler places under attention.
normalIntro.cn: subject 是课程、研究或统治者置于关注之下的东西。

normal.en: The subject of today's lesson is the weather.
normal.cn: 今天这节课的主题是天气。

normal.en: History is her favourite subject.
normal.cn: 历史是她最喜欢的科目。

normal.en: The subjects were asked to sleep well.
normal.cn: 受试者被要求好好睡觉。

normal.en: The schedule is subject to change.
Let us change the subject.

abstract.en: Every subject is a world someone chose to look at.
abstract.cn: 每个主题，都是有人选择去看的一个世界。

abstract.en: To be subject to time is to be human.
abstract.cn: 受时间支配，就是做人。

abstract.en: The subject of a life is rarely written down.
abstract.cn: 一生的主题，很少被写下来。

examples.en: The subject of today's lesson is the weather.
examples.cn: 今天这节课的主题是天气。

examples.en: History is her favourite subject.
examples.cn: 历史是她最喜欢的科目。

examples.en: The schedule is subject to change.

dict_mnemonic.text: subject 是「主题」，也指学校「科目」和研究「对象」；be subject to 是易受……影响，change the subject 是换个话题，subject matter 是题材。

root: 来自拉丁语 subicere（置于下方）的过去分词 subiectus，经古法语 sujet 进入英语；由被置于权力之下，引申为被讨论、被研究、被教授的对象，以及易受某种影响。

sensesIntro.en: Subject is a topic, a school course, a study object, or being open to an effect.
sensesIntro.cn: subject 是主题、学校科目、研究对象，或易受某影响。

core.en: Something placed under the eyes of others.
core.cn: 被放到众人目光之下的东西。

branches.en: The subject of today's lesson is the weather.
branches.cn: 今天这节课的主题是天气。

branches.en: History is her favourite subject.
branches.cn: 历史是她最喜欢的科目。

branches.en: The subjects were asked to sleep well.
branches.cn: 受试者被要求好好睡觉。

branches.en: The schedule is subject to change.
branches.cn: 日程可能会有变动。

branches.en: A course of study and a study object share one word.
branches.cn: 学习的科目和研究的对象共用一个词。

intro.en: Subject builds adjectives and nouns with -ive and -ion.
intro.cn: subject 借助 -ive 和 -ion 构成形容词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base iect- meant thrown.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 iect- 意为投掷。

items.meaning: a topic or a ruled person

items.example: He was subjecting them to questions.

items.exampleCN: 他们生活在被统治之中。

latinEntries.exampleCN: subiectus 演变为英语的 subject。

definition_en: to go under water, or to put something under water
core_image: 水面漫过头顶，一切声音都被压下去
scene: 洪水淹没了整条街道。The flood submerged the whole street.
sceneCN: 这里 submerge 是「淹没」（第 1 个义项）；句意：洪水淹没了整条街道。

senses.title: Flood over
senses.definition: to cover something completely with water
senses.definitionCN: 用水把某物完全盖住
senses.example: The flood submerged the whole street.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水淹没了整条街道。
senses.why: This is the main physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的物理义项。

senses.title: Go under
senses.definition: to go below the surface of water
senses.definitionCN: 沉到水面以下
senses.example: The submarine submerged quietly.
senses.exampleCN: 潜艇悄悄潜入水下。
senses.why: The same word works without an object.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也可不带宾语使用。

senses.title: Hide under
senses.definition: to be so involved that other things disappear
senses.definitionCN: 深陷其中，使其他事物仿佛消失
senses.example: She submerged herself in her work.
senses.exampleCN: 她把自己埋进工作里。
senses.why: Being under water images being lost in something.
senses.whyCN: 没入水中，被用来比喻沉浸在某事里。

intro.en: Submerge joins Latin sub, under, with mergere, to plunge.
intro.cn: submerge 由拉丁语 sub（在下）与 mergere（投入）组合而成。

items.en: Sub meant under.
Mergere meant to plunge into water.
Submerge meant to put under water.
items.cn: submerge 意为把某物放入水下。

items.en: Submerge also meant to sink below the surface.
items.cn: submerge 也意为沉到水面以下。

items.en: Submerge gained the sense of being absorbed.
items.cn: submerge 获得了沉浸其中的含义。

note.en: Submerge is compared with look-alike words and with words for sinking.
note.cn: 把 submerge 与形近词以及表示下沉的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To submerge is to go under, whether water or work.
normalIntro.cn: submerge 就是没入下面，无论是水还是工作。

normal.en: The flood submerged the whole street.
The submarine submerged quietly.
She submerged herself in her work.
The rocks were submerged at high tide.
Do not submerge the pump in water.

abstract.en: Some feelings submerge and wait for a season.
abstract.cn: 有些情感会潜下去，等一个季节。

abstract.en: What is submerged still shapes the surface.
abstract.cn: 沉在水下的东西，仍在塑造水面。

abstract.en: To submerge is not to disappear.
abstract.cn: 没入水中，并不等于消失。

examples.en: The flood submerged the whole street.
The submarine submerged quietly.
She submerged herself in her work.

dict_mnemonic.text: submerge 是「淹没、浸没」，也可表示「潜入水中」或「沉浸」；be submerged 是被淹没，fully submerged 是完全浸没，submerge oneself in 是沉浸于。

root: 由拉丁语 sub（在下）与 mergere（投入、浸入）组合，经法语或直接进入英语；字面是「投入到下面」，因此表示淹没、潜入水中，以及沉浸在某事里。

sensesIntro.en: Submerge means to flood over, to go underwater, or to be absorbed in something.
sensesIntro.cn: submerge 表示淹没、潜入水下，或沉浸于某事。

core.en: A surface closing over something.
core.cn: 水面在某物之上合拢。

branches.en: The flood submerged the whole street.
branches.cn: 洪水淹没了整条街道。

branches.en: The submarine submerged quietly.
branches.cn: 潜艇悄悄潜入水下。

branches.en: She submerged herself in her work.
branches.cn: 她把自己埋进工作里。

branches.en: Water covering a thing and a thing going under are two sides.
branches.cn: 水盖住东西，和东西沉下去，是同一件事的两面。

branches.en: Going underwater images being lost in a task.
branches.cn: 潜入水下，被用来比喻沉入一件事。

intro.en: Submerge takes -sion and -ible to build its family.
intro.cn: submerge 借助 -sion 和 -ible 构成同族词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base merg- meant to plunge.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 merg- 意为投入水中。

items.example: The tide will submerge the path.
The river submerges the field each spring.
items.exampleCN: 这条河每年春天淹没田地。
汽车有一部分被水淹没。

items.example: Submersion in cold water is dangerous.
The sun emerged from the clouds.

items.exampleCN: 语言沉浸有助于学习者。

latinEntries.example: Mergere gave English merge and submerge.
latinEntries.exampleCN: mergere 演变为英语的 merge 和 submerge。

definition_en: to give something for others to consider, or to accept someone's power
core_image: 把文件双手递上去，也把头低下去
scene: 请在周五前提交申请。Please submit your application by Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 submit 是「提交」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请在周五前提交申请。

senses.title: Hand in
senses.definition: to give a document or plan to someone in authority
senses.definitionCN: 把文件或计划交给有权处理的人
senses.example: Please submit your application by Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 请在周五前提交申请。
senses.why: This is the common official sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是常见的公务义项。

senses.title: Yield
senses.definition: to accept the power or control of another
senses.definitionCN: 接受他人的权力或控制
senses.example: They refused to submit to the new rules.
senses.exampleCN: 他们拒绝服从新规定。
senses.why: Handing something up becomes bowing down.
senses.whyCN: 把东西递上去，引申为低头服从。

senses.title: Argue
senses.definition: to suggest or argue formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式地提出或主张
senses.example: The lawyer submitted that the evidence was weak.
senses.exampleCN: 律师主张证据不足。
senses.why: Law places a claim before the court.
senses.whyCN: 法律把主张呈到法庭面前。

intro.en: Submit joins Latin sub, under, with mittere, to send.
intro.cn: submit 由拉丁语 sub（在下）与 mittere（送）组合而成。

items.en: Submittere meant to send under or yield.
items.cn: submittere 意为送到下面或屈服。

items.en: The past form submissus meant lowered.
items.cn: 过去分词 submissus 意为被放低的。

items.en: Submit meant to yield to power.
Submit meant to present a document.

items.en: Successive now describes an unbroken series.
items.cn: 如今 successive 形容没有中断的一串。

note.en: Successive is compared with look-alike words and with words for repeated order.
note.cn: 把 successive 与形近词以及表示重复顺序的词作比较。

entries.definition: a series of things in order

normalIntro.en: Successive things walk one behind another.
normalIntro.cn: successive 的东西，一个跟在一个后面走。

normal.en: It rained for five successive days.
Successive governments ignored the problem.
normal.cn: 历届政府都忽视这个问题。

normal.en: She visited the city on successive days.
normal.cn: 她接连几天都去那座城市。

normal.en: The team won three successive games.
Successive attempts finally worked.

abstract.en: Successive mornings teach us what a year is.
abstract.cn: 一个接一个的早晨，教会我们一年是什么。

abstract.en: History is successive forgettings.
abstract.cn: 历史，就是一串接一串的遗忘。

abstract.en: Each successive step makes the last one shorter.
abstract.cn: 每多走一步，上一步就显得更短。

examples.en: It rained for five successive days.
Successive governments ignored the problem.
examples.cn: 历届政府都忽视这个问题。

examples.en: The team won three successive games.

dict_mnemonic.text: successive 是「连续的、相继的」；successive years 是连续几年，successive governments 是历届政府，其名词是 succession，副词是 successively。

root: 来自中世纪拉丁语 successivus，词根为 sub（在后）与 cedere（走），字面是「跟在后面走的」，引申为连续不断的。

sensesIntro.en: Successive describes things, people, or periods that follow one another closely.
sensesIntro.cn: successive 形容事物、人或时期一个紧接一个出现。

core.en: One thing moving in right after another.
core.cn: 一个事物紧跟着另一个到来。

branches.en: It rained for five successive days.
branches.cn: 雨一连下了五天。

branches.en: Successive governments ignored the problem.
branches.cn: 历届政府都忽视这个问题。

branches.en: Days and governments can both follow a line.
branches.cn: 日子和政府都可以排成一条线。

branches.en: The team won three successive games.
branches.cn: 球队连赢三场。

branches.en: Successive generations kept the story alive.
branches.cn: 一代又一代人把这个故事传了下去。

intro.en: Successive builds successively and succession.
intro.cn: successive 可构成 successively 和 succession。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base cess- meant to go or come after.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 cess- 意为走或随后而来。

items.example: Three successive wins lifted the team.
items.exampleCN: 连续三场胜利让球队士气大振。

latinEntries.example: Successivus is the source of successive.
latinEntries.exampleCN: successivus 是 successive 的来源。
succedere 演变为英语的 succeed。
